article.title: Statement from UAW President Shawn Fain and UAW Vice President Ryan Hiestand on Delphi Retirees
article.author: Justin Mayhugh
article.content: The UAW is happy to announce that GM has agreed to honor its commitments to Delphi retirees who were denied annual lumpsum payments in 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026. The remaining eligible Delphi retirees will receive a $2,000 payment in or about March 2027 covering prior years, and a future $500 payment in December 2027. Let’s be clear. This issue never should’ve taken this long to resolve. While GM makes a record $20 billion payout to Wall Street, certain Delphi retirees have had to wait years to get what they’ve been owed. Through the diligence of the UAW, and the members who raised their voices, we have made things right, and will keep fighting for every single member to get their fair share.
